title: County buying private West Maui water systems
summary: As of Sept. 30, the Council has approved buying three West Maui water systems, which a member said will increase public control. The County still delivers only 23 percent of West Maui water, with private companies delivering 77 percent, and it is still checking details on other systems, aiming for about 90 percent public control. The Aug. 25 purchase of private assets for up to $6 million passed 8–1.
